text:
[Council File 26-1240; CD 14]
Municipal Facilities Committee report relative to authorizing the Department of General Services to negotiate and execute a license agreement with P&Y Broadcasting Corporation, for the placement of equipment and the use of the rooftop in support of the City’s 911 operation, at 4600 Carter Drive in Council District 14.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 2, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - OCTOBER 30, 2026)

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 2, 2026)
